recognition.summary: Valid, reproducible reports leading to meaningful security improvements qualify for public recognition.

reporting.summary: The official policy provides direct security-team reporting email.

rewards.summary: The university explicitly offers no monetary or material rewards.

limitations: The policy requires stopping at the first finding and requesting permission before continuing.
Automated scanners are prohibited; public disclosure requires explicit written permission.
